subject: SIG v12: structure update and re-answer request
messages:
From: Helen Park <helen.park@nimbus-payments.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Payments Security Team <security@nimbus-payments.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SIG v12 — structural changes and re-answer request

Hi Stephanie,

Quick heads-up: Nimbus just published SIG v12. We've done a reorganization (merged several control groups, renumbered sections) which means existing answers submitted against v11 won't map cleanly. We need updated answers from vendors for the new schema and a short diff showing what changed relative to v11.

Request: can Redwood provide: 1) a completed SIG v12 sheet with re-answers where the meaning changed, 2) a short PDF diff that highlights moved/renamed controls, and 3) any evidence files for controls that reference new sub-controls (particularly the data-retention and key-management items).

Timeline: Nimbus prefers re-answers by 2026-03-03 to keep our vendor review on schedule. If you need a staged delivery (partials first), let us know.

I've attached the official SIG v12 template and a short change-log from our side.

Best,
Helen
Security Programs Manager
Nimbus Payments

[Attachment: SIG-v12-template.xlsx (application/vnd-openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG v12 — structural changes and re-answer request

Hi Helen — thanks for the update and the template. We can do this. Proposed plan:

- Split by ownership: Aditya will coordinate commercial/HUB updates; Lauren will triage any legal/attestation language; I will own the technical answers and gather evidence.
- Deliver a first-pass re-answer workbook for the critical controls (A.* series and encryption/key management) by 2026-02-26, and the full re-answer by 2026-03-02.
- We'll also provide a PDF diff that marks moved/renamed controls relative to v11.

Two quick clarifications: 1) in SIG v12 the data-retention controls appear to be split into two sub-controls (A.13.1 / A.13.2) — should we map our previous v11 answer to both or flag as "split — please review"? 2) are there any controls you consider "blockers" that must be fully answered by 02/26?

Aditya / Lauren — looping you in to confirm timelines and RACI.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Steph / team — quick legal/attestation note:

- If v12 introduces new attestation language (e.g., explicit sub-controls for third-party key custodians), we need to confirm whether a simple mapping of the old answer is acceptable or if a new legal attestation is required.
- For control A.13 (retention), please collect the retention matrix and a sample deletion log. If we can't supply a deletion log for a requested range, call it out explicitly in the workbook so Nimbus knows where to ask follow-up questions.

I have time to review the re-answers on 02/27 afternoon; please target the first-pass to be ready by then so I can do a legal pass.

-Lauren

Helen — attaching our first-pass re-answers for SIG v12. Summary:

- Re-answered 42 controls that changed meaning or were split during v11->v12 migration. Each changed control has a short rationale in the "Notes" column.
- For split controls (e.g., v11 A.13 -> v12 A.13.1 / A.13.2) we mapped the original answer to both sub-controls and added a note "mapped from v11 — please review" where the implementation differs.
- Evidence bundle attached for A.13 (retention matrix + sample deletion log).
- Attached PDF highlights the diff (moved/renamed rows) for quick reviewer scanning.

Attachments included:
- SIG-v12-reanswers.xlsx (workbook with re-answers and notes)
- SIG-v12-diff.pdf (visual diff from v11 -> v12)
- control-A13-evidence.zip (retention matrix, sample deletion log, policy excerpt)

We expect to produce a final pass with any clarifications by 2026-03-02. Please let us know if Nimbus wants an interim call to walk through the bigger changes.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
